svg.title: Jet grouting — Þrýstisprautun í jarðveg
svg.desc: A slender drilled injection rod emits separated lateral and angled jets within a deep treated-soil column.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-jet-grouting","label_en":"Jet grouting","label_is":"Þrýstisprautun í jarðveg","section":"04","category_en":"Excavation, foundations and ground engineering","category_is":"Uppgröftur, undirstöður og jarðtækni","batch":2,"tags":["ground-improvement","grouting"],"description":"A slender drilled injection rod emits separated lateral and angled jets within a deep treated-soil column.","design_note":"Jets emerge from the lower rod without mixing paddles, visually separating jet grouting from mechanical soil mixing.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
